description:
Moro is a light, simple, and friendly way to enjoy Mastodon.

Built around three ideas — light, simple, friendly — Moro gives you a calm, refined home in the fediverse. No clutter, no ads, no noise: just your timeline and the people you follow.

Bring your own account on any Mastodon server and start reading, posting, and connecting with a client that stays out of your way.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Read your home timeline in a clean, distraction-free layout
• Follow conversations with clear, threaded replies
• Post, reply, and quote — with drafts, polls, media, alt text, content warnings, and per-post visibility
• Catch up on mentions, boosts, favorites, and follows in a dedicated activity view
• Boost, favorite, and bookmark with a single tap
• Explore profiles and search posts, people, and hashtags
• View media beautifully, with content-warning and sensitive-media handling that respects your choices
• Translate posts written in other languages
• Choose from multiple app icons to make Moro your own

THOUGHTFULLY BUILT
• Light and fast, designed for iOS
• Full Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support
• Share links and text into Moro from other apps
• Privacy-first: no ads, no tracking. Your account and content stay between you and the server you choose — we collect only anonymous crash diagnostics to fix bugs.

Moro works with any Mastodon instance. Sign in and make the fediverse feel light again.
promotionalText: Meet Moro — a calm, refined Mastodon client built to feel light, simple, and friendly. Bring your own account and enjoy the fediverse without the noise.
whatsNew:
Moro 1.1 is a fresh start:
• A new welcome and sign-in: a starry net gathers into a globe, and typing your server's domain lights up its star
• Multiple accounts: sign in to more than one and switch with a long press on Me
• Appearance: pick a theme color and adjust post text size
• Profile: edit everything on one page, and replace or remove your avatar and header with ease
• Save and share images from posts, plus new sensitive content settings
• Turn on new-post alerts for people you follow
• Fixed discovery not loading in Search on some servers, and other improvements
